body:
Founder real-time: 'also a parena based busybox to go with it.' Matches PARENA_COREUTILS_NORTHSTAR.md's Phase 1 roadmap exactly. Real PARENA logic where it exists (count-lines, head-should-print?, yes-line, matching echo.prn's own argv-in-host/logic-in-PARENA split); cat/sleep/env are host-only pure I/O/syscall utilities matching true/false's precedent. 13 new end-to-end tests, all pass; full suite 347/347, zero regressions. Live-verified natively (all 6 new applets, real behavior including real 1s sleep timing and real PATH in env output). Commit 60256bb.

⚓ ☃
title: parenabusybox Phase 1 shipped: wc, head, yes, cat, sleep, env
